description: Offset / page-number pagination for the Paginator pagination library. Provides Paginator, MutablePaginator, PagingCore, PaginatorPrefetchController, the offset DSL, eviction strategies, and the offset serialization layer. Builds on paginator-core. Pick this module for classic page-based feeds (page 1, 2, 3 …); for cursor / GraphQL-connection-style feeds use paginator-cursor instead.
